metadata.title: Davivienda API Marketplace
metadata.description: Davivienda's API marketplace for exploring open banking products and use cases.

hero.title: Connect your business to the financial ecosystem and scale your operations.
hero.description: Davivienda APIs help you process sales, pay suppliers, and reconcile balances in real time. Build unique financial experiences for your customers.

growth.title: New ways to grow
growth.description:
Embed financial services
into your own product and
unlock revenue opportunities
that were previously out of reach.

easyStart.title: Get started with confidence
easyStart.description:
Everything is ready from day one:
clear documentation and a
sandbox where you can
experiment with confidence.

security.title: Confidence at every step
security.description:
Davivienda supports every connection,
protecting your business and preserving
the trust of your customers.

scalability.title: Grow at your own pace
scalability.description:
Start small and scale when
you are ready. Our technology
grows alongside your business.

useCases.title: See what your business can achieve
useCases.description: Explore real business scenarios you can bring to life. Choose the one closest to your vision and discover how to make it happen.

checkout.title: Accept payments at checkout
checkout.description: Collect payments directly from your customer's account, with immediate confirmation and a digital receipt.

payroll.title: Process payroll and bulk payments
payroll.description: Pay hundreds of beneficiaries in a single run, with per-record tracking and duplicate-payment controls.

accounts.title:
Display balances and
transactions in your app
accounts.description: Give customers real-time access to balances, transactions, and detailed activity within your own application.

identity.title: Frictionless digital onboarding
identity.description: Verify customer identities digitally using facial biometrics and document validation.

cards.title: Issue virtual cards instantly
cards.description: Create virtual cards for secure online purchases, with full control over spending limits and expiration.

notifications.title: Reconcile transactions in real time
notifications.description: Receive immediate transaction notifications to streamline reconciliation and operational control.

finalCta.title: Ready to discuss your next idea?
finalCta.description: Find the right product for your business and take the first step. Our team is ready to support you.

explore.title: Explore and choose your product
explore.description: Browse the catalog and find the API that best fits what you want to achieve.

registerInterest.title: Tell us what you need
registerInterest.description: Share your details and select the product you are interested in. It is quick and requires no commitment.

activateCredentials.title: Activate your credentials
activateCredentials.description: We review your request and enable access so you can start building.

Footer.description: Developer platform for the Open Banking ecosystem. Build secure financial experiences on enterprise-grade banking infrastructure.
